name: powermise
description: An unofficial desktop companion for mise: see, install, and update every tool mise manages, from one window.

scripts.check: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked && bun run web:check && bun run desktop:check
scripts.desktop:check: bun run --cwd apps/desktop check && cargo clippy --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets --locked
scripts.web:deploy: bun run web:build && bun run --cwd apps/web deploy
scripts.clean: cargo clean && cargo clean --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml && rm -rf apps/web/dist apps/web/.astro apps/desktop/dist
